svg.title: agentic-science-framework
svg.desc: Agentic science as three layers: core capabilities (bottom) support a four-stage research cycle (middle) that is applied across scientific disciplines (top). Generic labels. Script-drawn schematic: layout, text and icons are generated by build.py as vector shapes (no bitmaps, no AI-generated icons).

g.text: Disciplines: where the agent is applied
Process: one research cycle run by the agent
Capabilities: what the agent brings to every stage
capabilities support every stage of the cycle
the same cycle is applied across disciplines
